arabic text: ZAINAB JO SHAAM AYEE HAAY LUT KE KARBALA SE\n(TASVEER FATEMA KI) MOHTAJ THI RIDAA SE
english translation text: When Zainab came to Shaam after being plundered in Karbala,\nthe image of Fatima stood in need of a veil.

arabic text: MEI HU ALI KI BETI, HAI MERA NAAM ZAINAB\nMAJME ME FAASIKOW KE, THI HAM KALAAM ZAINAB\n(QAYDI JO KAR LIYA HAI) BOLO TO KUCH HAYA SE
english translation text: ‘I am Ali’s daughter; my name is Zainab.’\nAmong the gathering of sinners, Zainab addressed them:\n‘You have made us prisoners—at least speak with some shame.’

arabic text: JAB KAFILE PE SHAAMI, PATHAR GIRAA RAHAY THAY,\nKATT KER JIGAR KE TUKRE, ANKHO ME AARAHAY THAY\n(DEHKHA GAYA NA MANZAR) YEH DARD KE KHUDAA SE
english translation text: When the people of Shaam rained stones upon the caravan,\npieces of the heart seemed to tear away and enter the eyes.\nSuch a scene could not be borne—even by the God of sorrow.

arabic text: NOKEY SENA PE NATIQ, QUR’AN RO RAHA HAI\nKARYAH BEEMAR KI AUR, ZINDAAN RO RAHA HAI\n(BECHEN THI SAKINA), HAI KHAWF KI WAJHA SE
english translation text: Upon the spear, the speaking Qur’an weeps;\nthe ailing one cries, and the prison itself weeps.\nSakina was restless because of fear.

arabic text: ZAHRA KI BETIYO PE, PATTHAR GIRAA NE WAALO,\nTAFSEER INNEMAA KO, QAYDI BANANE WAALO\n(SOWCHO BACHO GE KAYSE) ZAHRA KI BAD'DUA SE
english translation text: O those who rained stones upon Zahra’s daughters,\nwho made the explanation of Innama into prisoners—\nthink: how will you escape Zahra’s curse?

arabic text: HAI KOWN AB DILAYE CHADAR MERI SHIMAR SE,\nNEZE SE KINCHLI HAI, ZALIM NE MERE SAR SE\n(ITNAA TO KEHDE KOI) ABBAS BAAWAFA SE
english translation text: Who will now bring me back my veil from Shimr?\nThe tyrant pulled it from my head with the spear.\nWill someone at least tell Abbas, the faithful one?

arabic text:
GHAR PAAK FATEMA KA, SHAAMI JALAA RAHAY TEH,
YEH DEKH KAR FARISHTE,ANSOO BAHA RAHAY THEH,
(KYA KHOOB HAI NIBAAYI) UMMAT NE MUSTAFA SE
(ROTI KHARI HAI BIBIYAA) SEHMI HUWI JAFAA SE
english translation text:
The people of Shaam burned the pure house of Fatima;
seeing this, the angels shed tears.
How well the ummah repaid Mustafa!
The frightened ladies stand weeping from this cruelty.
